sources.title: Restricting and Limiting the Entry of Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The White House publishes the signed Presidential Proclamation 10998 and its country-specific restrictions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The entry into the United States of nationals of Burkina Faso as immigrants and as nonimmigrants is hereby fully suspended.

sources.title: 8 CFR 212.1, Documentary requirements for nonimmigrants
sources.publisher: eCFR, Office of the Federal Register
sources.officialityEvidence: The current eCFR publishes the federal nonimmigrant documentary regulation, including Guam-CNMI provisions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A valid unexpired visa and an unexpired passport shall be presented by each arriving nonimmigrant alien.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38), geographical definition of United States
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official U.S. Code publication defines the INA's geographical United States to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and CNMI.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
